opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guests, filters and price sort
opportunities.description: On Kayak Stays, search hotels for a {destination} between {check_in} and {check_out} for {rooms}/{adults}/{children}, optionally apply filters, and sort by price low to high.
steps: Click 'Stays' (Search for hotels) in the left nav
Type {destination} in the location box and pick the matching suggestion
Open the calendar and click {check_in} then {check_out}
Open rooms/guests and use the +/- buttons to set {rooms}, {adults}, {children} (and child ages)
Click Search
Apply optional filters on the results page ({hotel_class}, {review_score}, amenities, style)
Open the 'Sorted by' dropdown and choose 'Price (low to high)'

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27 – Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sorted by price low to high
Santa Fe, NM; Jun 16 – Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults

Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6 – Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults + 1 child (age 7); review 8+, 3+ stars, Free internet, Family, Air-conditioned; sorted by price low to high (a Qatar flight-status lookup happened in the middle)
Los Angeles, CA; May 21 – May 23; 1 room, 2 adults; 4- and 5-star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, search one-way flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date} with a {passenger_mix} and {cabin_class}, then select a fare for each flight leg.
steps: Open the Book flights widget (directly, or from an Explore destination page)
Type {origin} in From and pick the airport suggestion
Type {destination} in To and pick the airport suggestion (skip if already filled)
Open the Depart date picker, click {depart_date}, and click Continue
Open Passengers / Class, use +/- to set adults, children and infants, choose {cabin_class}, and click Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
Click the fare box for the chosen flight, then click 'Select fare' on the chosen fare family
For a connecting or stopover trip, repeat the fare selection for the next leg

instances.values: Colombo CMB → New York JFK (Qatar Stopover); 24 Jun 2023; 2 adults, 1 child; Business; Business Comfort on both legs (IGN browsing happened in the middle)
Doha DOH → Durban DUR (reached via Explore > Africa > Durban); 28 May 2023; 2 adults, 1 infant; Economy; Economy Comfort

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways partner hotel search (Booking.com)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways Book > Hotels, search Booking.com hotels in {destination} for {check_in}–{check_out} with {adults}/{rooms}, apply filters or sorting, and open a property's availability.
steps: Click 'Book' in the Qatar Airways top nav, then click 'Hotels'
Type {destination} in 'Where are you going?' and pick the suggestion
Open the calendar, move to the right month, and click {check_in} and {check_out} (or click a +N days chip)
Click Search
Set the occupancy ({adults}, {children}, {rooms}) and click Done if it needs changing
Apply filters such as neighbourhood, star rating or facilities, or sort by 'Price (lowest first)'
Click 'See availability' on the chosen hotel, then click Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; Apr 10 – Apr 16 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sorted by Price (lowest first)
Washington DC; Jun 5 – Jun 6 2023; 4 adults, 2 rooms; Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars; picked St. Regis and clicked Reserve
